scope: Entire generated index.html and every IdentityTheme homeRoute, including head metadata, navigation, text, images, attributes, catalogue output and footer.
method: Algebra-owned lexical HTML scan with quote-aware tags and attributes; nonempty text and every attribute, including id are observed. Only exact element selector and property references are reconciled. No equality-based intent inference or ancestor/subtree coverage.
boundary: This scans the five generated homepage documents, not every corpus destination or live DOM state. Comments, doctype and formatting whitespace are excluded. Inline script/style bodies and external script/stylesheet dependencies are opaque and remain undecided unless precisely declared. CSS internals, runtime-only states, shadow DOM, frames and semantic/visual fitness are not certified. Token ordinals are byte-rendering evidence addresses, not stable DOM paths.
